name: harness-write
title: Harness Writing
description: [slots] Alone: your drafts. Text: write it. Draft and update writing for people: evidence-grounded feature docs, onboarding, and troubleshooting guides; stakeholder trackers, meeting invites, and email updates or thread replies; and dashboards, reports, and queries; slots ranks meeting times offline. Shorthand: /hn-write. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on rationale, harness-monitor on status and owner evidence, harness-dev on report implementation, kpi-dashboard and jarvis-metrics on report design, and the office-documents and ppt-master references on document output. Drafts only: never sends, invites, shares, or publishes without explicit approval.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Menu word: slots. Alone, the skill confirms a target clear from the conversation or shows your drafts; other text writes what it describes. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: What to write, taken from the words: doc, tracker, meeting, email, or report; asked only when unclear.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Feature or doc set, initiative, email purpose, or report artifact, taken from the words or a target clear from the conversation; asked only when unclear.

inputs.name: audience
inputs.description: Doc audience. Reuse the established audience or clarify it. Partner access does not imply public disclosure.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Report platform. Infer only from an unambiguous request or existing artifact; otherwise ask.

inputs.name: thread
inputs.description: Exact subject of an existing mail thread: the reply-all target for email, and an attendee source for slots or meeting.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Explicit destination for a doc set or report. Otherwise reuse the coding repository's documentation convention, then docs/guides/<feature> when no convention exists.

examples: /harness-write status email to the platform team about the outage
/harness-write public docs for the monitor feature
/harness-write slots Alice and Bob next week, 30 minutes
